text: SubSync is installed. Open it from the menu in your CRM, and you land on Today.
The first sync runs in the background. It takes a few minutes, and the numbers appear as it finishes. The top bar tells you when it last updated.
Read Today first. It shows the money at risk, and the accounts to save first.
Pick your date range at the top, and the numbers follow it.
Then do the five-minute setup. Connect your own AI, if you want one. Save your alert email. And give your team roles: setter, closer, or both.
The Getting started checklist ticks itself off as you go, so you always know what is next.
Need help? Every page has a sixty-second guide, and the Help and support section is in Settings.
You are set. Open Today and start with the first account to save.
